name: @helix-db/helix-db
description: TypeScript library for working with  HelixDB
author: HelixDB

scripts.test:unit: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node dist-dev/test/basic.test.js && node dist-dev/test/client.test.js && node dist-dev/test/graph.test.js && node dist-dev/scripts/nested-dsl.test.js
scripts.test: npm run test:type && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:coverage: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-lines=75 --test-coverage-branches=70 --test-coverage-functions=60 dist-dev/test/basic.test.js dist-dev/test/client.test.js dist-dev/test/graph.test.js dist-dev/scripts/nested-dsl.test.js
scripts.parity:generate: npm run parity:generate:rust && npm run parity:generate:ts && npm run parity:generate:go && npm run parity:generate:python
scripts.test:parity: npm run parity:generate && npm run parity:compare-json && npm run parity:embedded && npm run parity:server-disk
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build
